severed-steel-v.1.0.0.description: _A stylish, acrobatic single-player FPS featuring dynamic voxel destruction by Greylock Studio_ **Randomizer Features** - All 51 Firefight 2.0 levels are supported - 2 goals to choose from: - `EdenSys Root Keys + Final Level`: Collect enough EdenSys Root Keys to unlock a Final Level and clear it - `EdenSys Root Key Hunt`: Collect a set number of EdenSys Root Keys spread across the multiworld - Ability to select individual levels to include / exclude from generation - Ability to customize how many levels (12-51) to play - Ability to specify a percentage of levels that will be required to play with a mutator active from various mutator pools - Ability to specify a percentage of levels that will be required to play in mirrored mode - Ability to generate up to 5 custom stylish action challenges per level that become locations (e.g. 3x Wall Bang, 7X Dive Frag) - Ability to set / randomize the difficulty of target rank scores / times. By level or globally - Option to play in Invincible Mode (to allow for more focus on style and comboing) - 8 unique traps to experience with configurable weights and durations - Scales well for all types of multiworlds: Short / Long Syncs, Asyncs; ~90-750 checks - Custom client UI that displays important information and updates in real-time - No manual mod installation required! The Archipelago client hooks into the game at runtime. Nothing else to download, install, or configure. - Feature-complete and considered stable **Locations** - Per Level: - Killing 10 / All Enemies - Killing 7 Enemies with Headshots - Obtaining B / A / S / S+ / S++ Ranks - Beating a Target Time - Completing the 2 Vanilla Challenges - Completing X Custom Stylish Action Challenges **Items** - Progressive Multiplier Burn Rate Reductions - Progressive Fresh Cooldown Reductions - Level Unlocks - Stylish Actions Licenses (for Custom Stylish Action Challenges) - Per Level: - 10% Target Time Discount - Double Score - Unlimited Ammo Unlocked - Unlimited Cannon Ammo Unlocked - Invincibility Unlocked **Setup Guide:** [Here](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/severed_steel/worlds/severed_steel/docs/setup_en.md)
severed-steel-v.1.0.0.title: Severed Steel - 1.0.0
